title.zh: Ondo urges SEC, CFTC to bring US stock perpetuals onshore

current_state.zh: Ondo Finance is urging the SEC and CFTC to allow US stock perpetual futures onshore under existing securities laws, citing $8 billion in volume from its offshore affiliate.
